description: Pattern-level composition recipes for agents — useWhen/avoidWhen without replacing pattern chrome.

patterns.name: CTASection
useWhen: marketing call-to-action band at section end
primary and secondary actions with title and description
inverse or primary background CTA block
avoidWhen: replacing shadcn CTA buttons with @dt/Button without variant parity review

variantNotes.inverseBackground: Production CTASection uses @/components/ui/button outline on dark bands — do not swap to @dt/Button tertiary without contrast check.

patterns.name: Header
useWhen: legacy site header with nav items and language switcher
avoidWhen: Next.js app shell — prefer SiteHeader in app routes
mass-replacing native header buttons with @dt/Button without design sign-off

variantNotes.chrome: Keep native <button> for language/theme controls unless explicitly redesigning header chrome.

patterns.name: HeroSection
useWhen: full-bleed marketing hero with alignment and background variants
homepage or landing hero shell with min-height
avoidWhen: blog article hero — prefer ArticleHero pattern
compact inline page title without hero imagery

variantNotes.background: Supports backgroundImage and tokenized min-height; compose children rather than hardcoding layout.
